mapper.select: select user_id as userId, primary_company_id as primaryCompanyId, is_default_installer_admin as isDefaultInstallerAdmin, status from ems_user_profile where user_id = #{userId} limit 1
select distinct r.role_key from sys_user_role ur inner join sys_role r on r.role_id = ur.role_id where ur.user_id = #{userId} and r.del_flag = '0'
select scope_type as scopeType, company_id as companyId, station_id as stationId from ems_user_scope where user_id = #{userId} order by id asc
select id, parent_id as parentId, ancestors from ems_company where del_flag = '0'

select distinct company_id from ems_station where del_flag = '0' and id in
#{stationId}
